observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly with a clear lens and an amber turn signal section.
The headlight has a modern design with a horizontal LED daytime running light strip.
The housing appears to be made of plastic with some visible wear and dirt.
There is a watermark 'PUREGOLDY CHOKO' across the center of the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight itself.
The item is placed on a dirty, possibly outdoor surface with debris around.

claims.claim: All Hyundai and Kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlight to confirm it is for Hyundai or Kia. The watermark 'PUREGOLDY CHOKO' is not a brand and may be a seller watermark.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight may not be genuine for Hyundai or Kia, or may be a counterfeit or non-genuine part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight's mounting points, backside, or any part number/label that identifies the OEM or manufacturer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or non-genuine part, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken internal components, cracked lens, or missing bulbs).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components, including the bulb sockets, reflectors, and wiring harness, and a video showing the headlight turning on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlight may be used or refurbished without disclosure, affecting its condition and value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the backside of the headlight with any part numbers, serial numbers, or wear indicators.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, which reduces value compared to new.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the backside of the headlight showing any part numbers or manufacturer labels.
A close-up photo of the internal components and bulb sockets.
A video or photo showing the headlight turned on to confirm functionality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
